approach: Reject symlinked Unity project roots and out-of-tree backup roots in both original SaveAndLoad path and Android offline source adapters before any source/backup write; bounded negative-control tests.
hypothesis: Existing Assets.is_symlink() check fails when the project directory itself is a symlink, and backup.resolve().is_relative_to() permits an out-of-tree backup symlink; original offline code can be redirected outside the intended staging roots.
next_step: Add early project/backup root checks and executable negative controls; preserve Windows/Android gameplay .rgd semantics and original identities.
